run_download_ego_per_segment: run the python script to download and decompress ReInterHand ego camera environment map data for all capture sessions
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch envmap_per_segment tar.gz files for a specific capture ID from S3
review_capture_id_list: review the capture_id_list variable containing 10 ReInterHand dataset capture session identifiers
review_name_list: review the name_list dictionary mapping capture IDs to their segment suffix names
refactor_download_function: refactor the download function to use requests or urllib instead of os.system wget and tar calls
